name: Ring Triceps Extension
steps: Grip gymnastic rings set around waist height, step back into a forward-leaning plank, and extend your arms straight ahead.
Brace your abdomen and keep your upper arms raised in front of your body throughout the movement.
Bend only your elbows smoothly to lower your forehead down between the rings under control.
Press firmly through your palms to extend your elbows completely back to the straight-arm start.
tips: Keep your elbows pointed forward and narrow rather than letting them flare wide to the sides.
Hold your body straight like a plank without letting your hips sag or pike.
